description: Beam with UDL and point load ground-truth match
message: A simply supported beam spans 12m, carries a 15kN/m downward UDL over the full span, and has a 50kN downward point load 4m from the left support. In addition to the load node, discretize the beam at midspan with a connected analysis node and report the midspan vertical deflection. Run static analysis.

assertions.description: The final response must report the requested midspan vertical deflection with its value, sign, unit, and location consistent with the current analysis artifact; no independently invented or contradictory value is acceptable.
